contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #369: The hot spots conjecture for simply connected planar domains.

Audit of thm:negative-kernel in staged Sections 4 and 5, with bounded nonnegative subcritical disk potentials and the exact boundary kernels; the full hot-spots theorem is not inferred from this mission alone.

definitions.D: open unit disk in R^2, with arclength measure on its unit circle
definitions.q: a dx with measurable 0<=a in L-infinity and integral psi^2 dq <= d integral |grad psi|^2 for all psi in H^1_0(D), for some 0<d<1
definitions.T f(x): integral G(x,y)f(y)dq(y); all boundary Poisson iterates are nonnegative kernel integrals, not unproved L^2(q) operations
definitions.K(p,s): P_s(p)+sum_{n>=1}(T^n P_s)(p); R(s,t)=sum_{n>=0} integral P_s T^n P_t dq; N(s,t)=1/(pi |s-t|^2)+R(s,t) for s!=t
definitions.P: at most one positive eigenvalue of a finite real symmetric matrix; all reciprocals are entrywise

contexts.statement: Green-chain reciprocal and boundary kernels for compact singular measures on the disk, extending the bounded-density audit.

definitions.D: open unit disk; S=unit circle with arclength measure
definitions.G(x,y): (1/(2pi)) log |(1-x conjugate(y))/(x-y)|, with infinite diagonal; P_s(x)=(1-|x|^2)/(2pi |s-x|^2)
definitions.nu: finite nonnegative Borel measure supported on a compact E contained in D
definitions.T_nu: the unperturbed Green integral operator on L2(nu), assumed bounded with norm strictly less than one
definitions.sections: G(x,.) belongs to L2(nu) for every x in D
definitions.K,R,N: the manuscript nonnegative chain kernels with nu in place of q; N(s,t)=1/(pi |s-t|^2)+R(s,t) off diagonal

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 369 (The hot spots conjecture for simply connected planar domains.; papers: Strict hot spots and absence of interior critical points on smooth simply connected planar domains; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/369.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For every q in CTX_RK and every p in D, D_p(s,t)=K(p,s)K(p,t)/N(s,t) off the diagonal and D_p(s,s)=0 is conditionally negative semidefinite on the unit circle, for every finite family and real coefficients summing to zero.

The nonnegative chain kernels K and N in CTX_RK are finite at their stated arguments; K(p,.) is bounded and positive, and R is symmetric, nonnegative and integrable with double integral at most q(D)/(1-d).

For every 0<epsilon<=1 there is a bounded continuous strictly positive kernel C_epsilon increasing to G as epsilon decreases to zero, including infinite diagonal, whose every finite entrywise reciprocal matrix has P.
For every finite real symmetric strictly entrywise positive matrix M whose entrywise reciprocal has P, every index z and every c>=0, the entrywise reciprocal of M_ij+c M_iz M_zj also has P.

For every compactly supported 0<=rho<=q, the kernel M^rho(x,y)=G(x,y)+<G(x,.),(I-T_rho)^(-1)G(y,.)>_rho has finite off-diagonal entries and infinite diagonal, and every finite reciprocal matrix with diagonal zero has P.
For every distinct finite boundary family s_i and p in D, the symmetric bordered matrix with B_ij=1/N(s_i,s_j) off diagonal, B_ii=0, border l_i=1/K(p,s_i), and last diagonal zero has P.

For every finite real symmetric B and real border l with positive entries, if [[B,l],[l^T,0]] has at most one positive eigenvalue, then x^T B x<=0 whenever l^T x=0; for any positive k with l_i k_i=1 this implies sum a_i a_j k_i B_ij k_j<=0 whenever sum a_i=0.

Manuscript thm:main: on every nonempty bounded smooth simply connected planar domain, every nonzero first positive Neumann eigenfunction has no interior critical point, hence strict hot spots. This remains an audit target, not a result of reciprocal-kernel certification alone.

Manuscript prop:vector: the divergence-curl quadratic form on tangent H^1 vector fields is bounded below by the first positive Neumann eigenvalue times L^2 norm, with equality precisely for gradients of first Neumann eigenfunctions; the curvature convention is positive on convex circles and opposite to Rohleder.

Manuscript Sections 2-4 and 6: the spectral gap, conformal regularity, multiplicity bound, vector form, multiplier identity and the conditional negativity of D_p imply absence of interior gradient zeros. These additional dependencies are not certified by proving only C_RK.

For every finite index type, real positive semidefinite matrix U, real a>0 and c>=0 with U_ii<a for all i, the matrix V_ij=U_ij/((1+c*a)*(1+c*a-c*U_ij)) is positive semidefinite. This is the universal Schur-resolvent core of the column update, not by itself a formalization of the PDE theorem.

For every finite index type, real positive semidefinite matrix U, real a>0 and c>=0 with U_ii<a for all i, the matrix V_ij=U_ij/((1+c*a)*(1+c*a-c*U_ij)) is positive semidefinite. This is the universal Schur-resolvent core of the column update, not by itself a formalization of the PDE theorem.

import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Order
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed
import Mathlib.Tactic

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators Topology
open Filter Matrix

namespace ReciprocalKernel

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

theorem psd_abs_entry_lt {U : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hU : U.PosSemidef)
    {a : ℝ} (hd : ∀ i, U i i < a) (i j : ι) : |U i j| < a := by
  classical
  have hs : U j i = U i j := by simpa using hU.isHermitian.apply i j
  have hp := hU.2 (Finsupp.single i 1 + Finsupp.single j 1)
  have hm := hU.2 (Finsupp.single i 1 + Finsupp.single j (-1))
  simp [Finsupp.sum_add_index, Finsupp.sum_neg_index, add_mul, mul_add, hs] at hp hm
  exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [hd i, hd j], by linarith [hd i, hd j]⟩

theorem psd_entrywise_power {U : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hU : U.PosSemidef)
    (n : ℕ) : Matrix.PosSemidef (fun i j => U i j ^ (n + 1)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hU
  | succ n ih =>
      convert! ih.hadamard hU using 1 <;> ext i j <;>
        simp [Matrix.hadamard_apply, pow_succ, Nat.add_assoc]

theorem psd_of_entrywise_limit {A : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℝ} {B : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ n, (A n).PosSemidef) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hlim : ∀ i j, Tendsto (fun n => A n i j) atTop (𝓝 (B i j))) :
    B.PosSemidef := by
  classical
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg hB
  intro x
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => star x ⬝ᵥ (A n *ᵥ x)) atTop
      (𝓝 (star x ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x))) := by
    change Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, star (x i) * (∑ j, A n i j * x j)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∑ i, star (x i) * (∑ j, B i j * x j)))
    apply tendsto_finsetSum
    intro i hi
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.mul
    apply tendsto_finsetSum
    intro j hj
    exact (hlim i j).mul_const (x j)
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto tendsto_const_nhds ht (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n =>
    (hA n).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x)

theorem scalar_schur_series {a c u : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hu : |u| < a) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => c ^ n / (1 + c * a) ^ (n + 2) * u ^ (n + 1))
      (u / ((1 + c * a) * (1 + c * a - c * u))) := by
  let α := 1 + c * a
  have hα : 0 < α := by dsimp [α]; positivity
  have hcu : c * u ≤ c * a :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((le_abs_self u).trans hu.le) hc
  have hden : 0 < α - c * u := by dsimp [α]; linarith
  have hr : |c / α * u| < 1 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg hc, abs_of_pos hα, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hα).2
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu.le hc
    dsimp [α]
    linarith
  have hsum := HasSum.mul_left (u / α ^ 2)
    (hasSum_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hr)
  have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hα
  have hden0 : α - c * u ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hden
  have hr0 : 1 - c / α * u ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    apply hden0
    field_simp [hα0] at he
    linarith
  change HasSum (fun n : ℕ => c ^ n / α ^ (n + 2) * u ^ (n + 1))
    (u / (α * (α - c * u)))
  convert! hsum using 1
  · funext n
    simp only [mul_pow, div_pow, pow_succ]
    field_simp [hα0]
  · field_simp [hα0, hden0, hr0]

theorem schur_resolvent_psd {U : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hU : U.PosSemidef)
    {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : ∀ i, U i i < a) :
    Matrix.PosSemidef
      (fun i j => U i j / ((1 + c * a) * (1 + c * a - c * U i j))) := by
  classical
  let A : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℝ :=
    fun n => (c ^ n / (1 + c * a) ^ (n + 2)) • (fun i j => U i j ^ (n + 1))
  have hA (n : ℕ) : (A n).PosSemidef := by
    apply (psd_entrywise_power hU n).smul
    positivity
  have hpartial (N : ℕ) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, A n).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun n hn => hA n)
  apply psd_of_entrywise_limit hpartial
  · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
    intro i j
    have hs : U j i = U i j := by simpa using hU.isHermitian.apply i j
    simp [hs]
  · intro i j
    simpa [A, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply] using
      (scalar_schur_series ha hc (psd_abs_entry_lt hU hd i j)).tendsto_sum_nat

theorem update_defect_identity {a c u : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hu : |u| < a) :
    a / (1 + c * a) - (a - u) / (1 + c * (a - u)) =
      u / ((1 + c * a) * (1 + c * a - c * u)) := by
  have h1 : 0 < 1 + c * a := by positivity
  have h2 : 0 < 1 + c * (a - u) := by
    have : 0 < a - u := by linarith [le_abs_self u]
    positivity
  have he : 1 + c * a - c * u = 1 + c * (a - u) := by ring
  rw [he]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt h1, ne_of_gt h2]
  <;> ring

theorem normalized_column_update_psd {H : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {a c : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hU : Matrix.PosSemidef (fun i j => a - H i j)) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < H i i) :
    Matrix.PosSemidef (fun i j => a / (1 + c * a) - H i j / (1 + c * H i j)) := by
  have hdiag : ∀ i, a - H i i < a := by intro i; linarith [hd i]
  convert! schur_resolvent_psd hU ha hc hdiag using 1
  ext i j
  have hu := psd_abs_entry_lt hU hdiag i j
  simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using update_defect_identity ha hc hu

end ReciprocalKernel

claims.natural_statement: For every nu in CTX_RK_MEASURE, all finite interior entrywise reciprocal Green-resolvent matrices, with zero diagonal, have at most one positive eigenvalue; all stated boundary K and off-diagonal R,N evaluations are finite, and for every interior p the kernel D_p=K(p,s)K(p,t)/N(s,t), with diagonal zero, is conditionally negative semidefinite. The hypotheses include unit length measure on [-1/2,1/2], which has no bounded area density.

For every compact measure in CTX_RK_MEASURE, fixed-epsilon positive quadratures for C_epsilon converge in operator norm with their inverses and evaluation vectors; subsequent monotone epsilon limits give the Green-chain resolvent; with compact support fixed, the radial evaluations divided by 1-r and (1-r)^2 converge to the exact finite K and N boundary kernels. No L2 boundary limit of a Poisson section on a noncompact support is required.
Audit target lem:gap: on a bounded smooth simply connected planar domain, the first positive Neumann eigenvalue is strictly less than the first Dirichlet eigenvalue.
Audit target lem:conformal: a conformal bijection from the disk to a bounded smooth simply connected planar domain extends to a smooth diffeomorphism of closures with nowhere vanishing derivative.

Audit target lem:boundary-weight: one smooth positive circle weight annihilates the pulled-back boundary traces of every first-positive-Neumann eigenfunction, and every nonzero such trace changes sign.
Audit target lem:nodal: a nonzero first-positive-Neumann eigenfunction has connected positive and negative sets, and its boundary trace has no four cyclically alternating strict signs.
Audit target prop:multiplicity: the real eigenspace of the first positive Neumann eigenvalue on a bounded smooth simply connected planar domain has dimension at most two.

Audit target lem:curvature: for tangent H^1 vector fields on the smooth domain, the integral of div(X)^2+curl(X)^2 equals the integral of the squared Cartesian gradient plus the boundary integral of kappa times |X|^2, with kappa positive on convex circles.

Audit target prop:multiplier: with conformal potential q=mu |Phi-prime|^2 dx, boundary eigenfunction gradient g and boundary vector energy E, E(bg) equals one half the double integral of N(s,t)(b(s)-b(t))^2 g(s) dot g(t) for every real Lipschitz scalar b.
Audit target in Section 6: the conditional-negative D_p kernel has an injective Lipschitz map from the unit circle into a real Hilbert space whose squared pairwise distances are D_p.

routes.retired_because: Agler-McCarthy arxiv:1610.01997v1 Corollary 1.12 concerns finite-valued positive definite irreducible reproducing kernels. It cannot alone justify the infinite-diagonal PDE Green kernel or its resolvent and boundary limits. The manuscript explicitly supplies separate arguments; retiring this shortcut is not a refutation of it.
